chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 153: Ji Ning Sets His Sights on the Black-White College
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning learns of the legendary Black-White Millstone Diagram, meets a condescending rival, and decides that the Black-White College is where he will rise.
